name: agent-recall
description: Cross-session memory for Codex CLI via the agent-recall service. Captures tool usage and session lifecycle, injects recalled memories on session start and prompt submit. Requires Node.js 18+ and a running agent-recall server.

interface.longDescription: Recall past decisions and session context, and record tool activity, through a local agent-recall server. Requires Node.js 18+ and a running agent-recall server (default http://127.0.0.1:8787). Set AGENT_RECALL_TOKEN when the server requires authentication.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about this project from previous sessions?
Recall decisions relevant to this repository.
